items.title: Nvidia’s Editor’s Day: New Windows-Based RTX Spark Computers - postPerspective
items.excerpt: By Mike McCarthy  Last week, I had the opportunity to attend Nvidia’s “Editor’s Day” in San Francisco, which was the company’s lead-up to the launch of its RTX Spark line of laptops and desktops. It was a day of presentations about AI, how the new hardware enables local AI processing and the benefits of that shift.
